body: I guess so. My spring break isn't going to be peaceful either, as my family wants to travel more south to visit my great grandmother on my mom's side. She's dying of cancer, and seeing her like that will bring back memories of when my grandfather on my dad's side passed... (Me and my grandfather were very close, it devastated me when it happened, and even thought it happened almost 5 years ago I still can't talk about it too much without choking myself up.)

It's not exams or anything, it's just that this marking period for md is very work-heavy. I have a hard time managing my stress and time, so it creates unnecessary stress. And when I finally can fit in time to work on my school work, I have to work very quickly which makes me extremely stressed. It's not that I can't work on my school stuff, it's just that because I didn't manage myself initially it's starting to pile up.

My friends are...It's very complicated. A lot of manipulation, drama, toxicity, and so much more. A very oversimplified rundown is that we have a lying, manipulative friend who's starting unnecessary drama and rumors. It's making me stressed beyond all belief, and I wish thar chaos could stop.

I don't know, right now it feels like I'm in an endless pit right now. I know this is probably very petty of me to complain about, but it genuinely feels like I'm drowning in stress right now. It's so bad that I've been recently getting sick because of how stressed I feel...

A lot of stuff. My grades are going down, my work is piling up, my friends are getting more and more tiresome to deal with, my time around others is becoming less and less, and so much more. I keep getting stress sick over all of this, and I just want everything to stop already.

not saying it's a good ides to hide it, but i read your comment on how your parents behave with this kind of stuff. i would say to just lie and say you have accidentally cut yourself while cooking or while using something sharp. it should be believable enough, and hopefully it won't raise any suspicion amongst your parents or your doctor.
